'''Shabiran''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Estijan]], an [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] great power and the fifth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city had a population of 13,218,000 at the [[Estijan|Estijan]] 1764 census, ranking it the [[List of cities and dependencies by population|twenty-first-largest city in the world]] by population. Shabiran is the political and cultural centre of the Estijan state, having served as the seat of the [[Estijan Huan]] through the Cold War period and as the capital of the successor [[Estijan]] state following the [[Collapse of the Huan]] in 1739–1740.
